name: Grilled skewers
summary: Skewers at the Da Lat night market, the sticks Visit Lâm Đồng already places under the lights.
origin: The night-market listing names skewers with the grilled rice paper. The food-tour note prices nướng xiên on its own.
howToEat: Buy a stick at the night stalls and eat it there. The meats on the stick are not listed. Check on arrival.
where: Da Lat Night Market. Visit Lâm Đồng puts the night stalls at about 18:00–23:00. A stall number is Check on arrival.
priceBand: The food-tour note prints 10,000–20,000 VND. The night-market listing does not print a skewer price.
